what_to_detect: A candidate for a modal spell with escalate is affordable with the escalate cost added once for each mode chosen beyond the first.
near_miss: A candidate for a spell with escalate that is unaffordable once the escalate cost for its extra modes is added.
record_fields: candidates[].ability (the spell's own line; Escalate is a separate keyword line on the same card)
resolution cost half costs.mana_by_color (what the chosen modes cost)
